recordQuestion.historySource: Historical source used by this answer
recordQuestion.title: Ask this record
recordQuestion.scope: Answers use only the selected original snapshot, excluding later additions and other meetings. Questions and answers are private to you. Each new question calls the model.
recordQuestion.question: Your question
recordQuestion.conflict: A question is still running, or the request conflicts. Try again shortly.
recordQuestion.denied: Unable to ask. Check source permissions or the source size limit.
recordQuestion.uncertain: The result is uncertain. Check the same request without calling the model again.
recordQuestion.unavailable: This question or its source is unavailable.
recordQuestion.noEvidence: The selected source does not contain enough evidence to answer this question.
recordQuestion.newAttempt: This attempt produced no usable answer. Explicitly submit a new request to try again; it may incur another model charge.

status.canceled: Source access or feature availability changed; canceled

summaryTasks.title: Convert actions to tasks
summaryTasks.explanation: Confirmation creates a separate task. Identical action text in this record reuses the existing task. Later summary edits do not change tasks.
summaryTasks.reused: This action was already converted. The existing receipt is reused; your form did not overwrite the task.
summaryTasks.conflict: The human minutes changed. Refresh the minutes and review the current action.
summaryTasks.denied: Unable to create. Check the assignee, date or current permissions.
summaryTasks.uncertain: The result is uncertain. Retry the same request.
summaryTasks.deleted: The previously linked task was deleted and will not be recreated automatically.
summaryTasks.hints: Summary descriptions: owner {{owner}}; deadline {{due}}. Make an explicit selection below.
summaryTasks.due: Confirm due date (leave blank for no due date)
summaryTasks.shareNotice: The selected assignee can read the task and receives notifications according to task settings. The full minutes and transcript are not shared.

humanReview.historyReadOnly: Historical revisions are read-only and cite their original snapshot. Return to the current revision to create tasks.
humanReview.title: Human-reviewed minutes
humanReview.explanation: Human revisions are preserved separately. AI regeneration cannot overwrite this draft. Saving does not create tasks.
humanReview.replace: Start another revision from the selected AI version
humanReview.draftNotice: Check the changes and citations. Discarding the draft removes your unsaved changes.
humanReview.conflict: A newer human revision exists. Your draft is preserved. Copy anything you need, discard the draft, then edit the latest revision.
humanReview.invalid: Unable to save. Check content, citations or editing access. Your draft is preserved.
humanReview.uncertain: The save result is uncertain. Retry the same save to avoid duplicate revisions.
humanReview.unavailable: Human revisions are unavailable. Refresh to try again.

recordAi.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait before resending the same request.
recordAi.waitForSource: Minutes can be generated after the meeting ends and a transcript is available.
recordAi.unavailable: Content is unavailable or your access has changed.
recordAi.accepted: Request saved. You can follow its progress here.
recordAi.conflict: The source or job changed. Review the latest status before trying again.
recordAi.requestDenied: Request not accepted. Check your access or try again later.
recordAi.uncertain: The request result is unknown. You can resend the same request.
recordAi.noVersions: No AI minutes have been generated yet.

asr.finished: Recognition tails received for observed audio
asr.incomplete: Recognition or transcript shutdown incomplete; check for missing content

recordAi.waitForStableSource: Waiting for more stable text or recognition tail closure before updating.
recordAi.nextUpdate: Next update available no earlier than {{time}}
recordAi.provisional: This draft uses text received at that time. Later speech may change the conclusions.
recordAi.observedThrough: Latest received text time: {{time}} (earlier audio coverage is not guaranteed)

automation.title: Automatic summaries
automation.description: When enabled, the server periodically summarizes received text and generates a recap and minutes after the meeting. This uses AI quota. This switch only controls summary generation.

state.waiting: Waiting for more text or recognition closure
state.needs_attention: Generation needs attention. Review the status and retry manually.

recordAi.sourceBudgetExceeded: The source exceeds the current processing budget, or one utterance is too long. Source text is retained; adjust the material before generating.

online.signIn: Sign in to view notes for this meeting
online.waiting: Notes are not available for this session yet. Saved text appears automatically when you have reading access.
online.textHint: Saved final transcripts. The latest page refreshes every 5 seconds.

capture.title: Meeting transcription
capture.description: Capture spoken words using speech recognition quota. Stopping ends live text capture. Cloud recording and automatic summaries are controlled separately.
capture.unavailable: Unable to confirm capture status. Please refresh.
capture.incompleteHint: This capture was interrupted or its final delivery is unconfirmed. Saved text remains available.
capture.conflict: The operation was not applied. State may have changed or a previous capture is still active. Check the current status.

state.stopping: Stopping and saving the final words…

info.name: Name
info.participantsHidden: Only the organizer can see the participant list

summary.empty: No summary yet (meeting not finished or summary not generated).
summary.aiUpdatedAfterEdit: The AI original was regenerated after your edit — showing your edited version.

actionItems.assigneesFailed: Failed to load assignees. Please try again.
actionItems.updateFailed: Failed to save the action item. Please try again.
actionItems.createTaskFailed: Failed to create the task. Please try again.

auth.title: Sign-in required
auth.body: Please sign in to view meeting details.

error.title: Unable to load
error.body: Failed to load the meeting detail. Please try again later.

home.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? If you own the meeting it will also be removed for everyone else.

chapters.empty: No chapters yet — they are generated with the summary.
chapters.jumpHint: Jump to this moment in the transcript

translation.title: Voice translation
translation.scope: Translate your current meeting microphone. Only you receive the translation. Recording stays separate.

state.incomplete: Translation interrupted; some content may be missing

translation.microphone: Turn on your microphone in the meeting toolbar first.
translation.pttHint: These buttons control translation input only. Other participants can still hear your meeting microphone. Hold Space or Enter to speak using the keyboard.
translation.otherDevice: Translation is running on another device. You can stop it here.
translation.uncertain: The result is unconfirmed. Retry the same operation.
translation.error: Translation connection or operation failed. Stop before trying again.
translation.historyHint: Shows the last 60 segments in this connection. Translations are not saved to meeting notes yet. Pausing listening does not stop translation.

share.sendFailed: Unable to share the meeting. Please try again.
